primaryEvidence.claim: Linear blend skinning, inverse bind transforms, joint/weight attributes; four influences is an implementation allowance, not an absolute mathematical limit.
Current joint transform multiplied by inverse bind maps bind-pose vertex into the current pose under column-vector convention.
Original author derivation retains reciprocal UV determinant, uses Gram–Schmidt, stores handedness and avoids averaging across UV discontinuities.
tangent.w stores +/-1; reconstruct bitangent from normal cross tangent times this sign.
Normal maps are linear data; sRGB transfer conversion is inappropriate for directional values.
Normal maps represent apparent surface detail through pixel normals instead of geometry displacement.

corrections.decision: Remove mixed PS2/first Tomb Raider historical attribution; preserve rigid hierarchy vs blended mesh comparison using independently made mannequin.
corrections.verification: Source's explicit correction callout; no unsupported platform claim remains.

corrections.decision: Four bones per vertex is configured example limit, not universal.

No translation for normal vectors; normalization plus weighted direction transform is a common approximation. Nonuniform scale/shear requires appropriate normal handling, and blended rotations need not remain orthogonal.
corrections.verification: Linear algebra plus source's normal-transform caveat; final implementation requires numerical QA.

corrections.decision: Make bind inverse and current matrix order explicit in one convention. Draft screen column-vector form J_current * B_bind^-1; transpose/reverse order if using source row-vector form.

No blanket modern claim that height maps are unsuitable. Basic XYZ packing is one format; normal maps use linear data. Exact 8-bit decode and renormalization shown, not pretending quantized tuple equals ideal (-.707,0,.707).
Use canonical bitangent term with binormal as alias; handedness sign reconstructs missing axis and renderer conventions must agree.

Transpose is inverse only for orthonormal basis; preserve determinant denominator/sign. Guard degenerate UVs and near-zero normalization. Plane mapping is not uniquely invertible for degenerate UV triangles.
Source code caption says averaged triangle normals, but algorithm averages tangents/bitangents. Narration and display corrected.
Split incompatible mirrored-UV seam vertices rather than averaging opposite tangent frames.
Retain preprocessed-data/runtime relationship; omit unverified universal 75/25 code-share claim.
